patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Flodesk and Mailjet share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Comparison thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Flodesk only if your buying job matches “Design-led creator ESP with beautiful templates and subscriber-tier Lite / Pro / Everythin” rather than Mailjet's shape. Choose Mailjet only if your buying job matches “EU-friendly email platform for marketing and transactional sending with send-volume pricin” rather than Flodesk's shape. Workflow advantage differs because Flodesk is shaped for Design-led creator ESP with beautiful templates and subscriber-tier Li whereas Mailjet is shaped for EU-friendly email platform for marketing and transactional sending wit. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Flodesk and Mailjet share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Flodesk is Design-led creator ESP with beautiful templates and subscriber-tier Lite / Pro / Everything plans.; Mailjet is EU-friendly email platform for marketing and transactional sending with send-volume pricing (Sinch)..
- Company-size focus: Flodesk (micro, small-business) vs Mailjet (micro, small-business, mid-market).
- Researched limits: Flodesk — Free plan is not a full forever-free ESP send tier; Mailjet — Free plan daily send cap (200/day).

Limitations — Flodesk: Free plan is not a full forever-free ESP send tier; Subscriber-tier pricing replaced legacy flat unlimited for new members; Mailjet: Free plan daily send cap (200/day); Automation depth concentrates on Premium+.

Poor-fit cases: Flodesk is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Free plan is not a full forever-free ESP send tier · Mailjet is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Free plan daily send cap (200/day) · Avoid Flodesk if you actually need Mailjet's motion (EU-friendly email platform for marketing and transactional sending with send-vol)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
